question: I cast a sorcery with buyback and pay its buyback cost, then copy that spell with [Fork]. Once everything resolves, how many copies of the card end up back in my hand?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Fork ruling 8 -- the copy is not a real card, so buyback returns only the ONE original. Expected: one. Rules-gold pending ablation; the ruling is the load-bearing element (rulings-RAG).

question: I have a face-down manifested card that's really [Lightning Bolt]. It dies and I imprint it on [Mimic Vat]. Later I activate Mimic Vat's copy ability -- do I get a token?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Mimic Vat ruling 0 -- can't token-copy a nonpermanent (instant) card, so NO token. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: My [Fiend Hunter]'s enters-the-battlefield ability is on the stack, about to exile a creature. I copy that ability with [Lithoform Engine] and target a second creature. Both get exiled. When Fiend Hunter later leaves the battlefield, do both come back?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Lithoform Engine ruling 4 -- the copied linked ability is also linked to the leaves-the-battlefield ability, so both exiled cards return. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: My own [Banishing Light] has an opponent's creature exiled. On my opponent's turn I cast [Teferi's Protection], phasing out my Banishing Light. Does the exiled creature return to the battlefield?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Teferi's Protection ruling 21 -- phasing out is not leaving the battlefield, so the 'until it leaves' return does NOT fire; creature stays exiled. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: I cast [Emrakul, the Promised End]. In response to its cast trigger, my opponent tries to [Counterspell] it. Can they even target it given protection from instants, and if it's countered, do I still control their next turn?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Emrakul ruling 2 (protection applies only on the battlefield, so Counterspell CAN target it on the stack) + ruling 3 (the cast trigger resolves even if Emrakul is countered). Expected: yes to both. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: My cascade spell exiles cards until it hits [Valki, God of Lies], whose back face is the seven-mana planeswalker Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor. Is that a legal cascade hit, and can I cast the Tibalt side for free?
note: Expected answer CORRECTED 2026-07-21 by grounding in the CR -- BOTH Jon and Claude first gave the pre-errata answer (thought you could cast Tibalt for free). CORRECT: it IS a legal cascade hit (Valki front-face MV 2 < cascade spell MV), and you may cast VALKI for free, but NOT Tibalt unless the cascade spell's MV is >= 8. Load-bearing: cascade rule 702.85a (the 'you may cast it if the resulting spell's mana value is less than this spell's' clause -- the errata that killed Tibalt-cascade; Tibalt's MV is 7) + Valki ruling 17 (in exile, MV = front face) + modal-DFC-not-transform (layout). Flagship case: the RAG got it right where expert + model memory did not. Rules-gold BY ABLATION: 702.85a is NECESSARY (removing the cascade rule with the resulting-mana-value clause breaks the answer); the MDFC-casting rules 712.11/712.8c/712.11d all tested REPLACEABLE (the enrichment already supplies the modal-DFC face data). A genuine rules-RAG test -- the load-bearing rule is a CR rule, not a card ruling.

question: I cast [Emrakul, the Promised End]. With its cast trigger on the stack, I copy that trigger with [Lithoform Engine]. Then I untap Lithoform Engine with [Voltaic Key] and use it again to copy [Emrakul, the Promised End] itself as a permanent spell. How many of my opponent's turns do I control, do I get a second Emrakul, and does copying the Emrakul spell give me another control-a-turn trigger?
note: Jon-approved multi-card. Load-bearing: Lithoform ruling 6 (the copied SPELL was never cast -> NO second cast trigger; the trap) + ruling 14 (permanent-spell copy becomes a token Emrakul) + ruling 7 (copy resolves first); Emrakul ruling 14 (control overwrites to one turn, extra turns stack). Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: I've imprinted a creature on [Mimic Vat] and activate its ability to make a token copy. While that ability is on the stack, I copy it with [Lithoform Engine]. Do I get two tokens?
note: Jon-approved multi-card. Load-bearing: Mimic Vat ruling 4 (token copies whatever is exiled at resolution) + Lithoform rulings 6/7 (copy created on the stack, resolves first) -> two tokens. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: An opponent controls an untapped [Trinisphere], and I have a permanent that makes my green spells cost {1} less. I want to cast [Awaken the Woods] for value. If I cast it with X=0, what does it cost and what do I get, and what X should I actually choose?
note: Jon-authored RULES-WARPER (rules-RAG case, not a ruling). Load-bearing: CR cost-calculation order (601.2f, increases then reductions) + Trinisphere ruling 0 (its floor is applied LAST, after reductions -- overrides the naive rule reading). Expected: X=0 costs 3 for zero tokens; cast for the largest X whose post-reduction cost is still <=3, never X=0. Rules-gold BY ABLATION: EMPTY -- the sanity check (remove ALL cited rules) HELD, so the CR rules are REDUNDANT here. Trinisphere ruling 0 (cost order: apply reductions, THEN Trinisphere; mana value unchanged) + the enriched {X}{G}{G} cost carry the answer. A 'rules-warper' that turned out RULING-carried (load-bearing = Trinisphere ruling 0, a rulings-RAG case), NOT a rules-RAG test.

question: [Grist, the Hunger Tide] is in my graveyard. Can I return it with [Animate Dead], and what happens?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Grist ruling 1 (only a creature OUTSIDE the battlefield; on the battlefield it's just a planeswalker) + Animate Dead rulings 1/4 (returns the card, then can't legally attach to a non-creature -> Animate Dead goes to the graveyard as an SBA -> its 'when this Aura leaves, sacrifice the creature' trigger fires). Expected (confirmed by Jon 2026-07-21): you CAN target Grist (creature card in the yard). Reanimation does NOT fizzle -- Grist DOES enter the battlefield, but as a planeswalker (not a creature), so Animate Dead can't legally attach -> Animate Dead is put into the graveyard as an SBA -> its leaves-the-battlefield trigger makes you sacrifice Grist immediately as he enters. Net: Grist enters and is instantly sacrificed, Animate Dead in the yard. The baseline bot was WRONG here (said Animate Dead stays attached, sacrifice only later) -- and the ruling was already dumped in-prompt, so it's a FAITHFULNESS miss, not a retrieval one. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: My commander [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] has four +1/+1 counters on it. It dies, I move it to the command zone, then recast it. Does it keep the counters, and does [Doubling Season] double them as it re-enters?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Skullbriar's zone-change persistence (counters remain moving to any zone other than hand/library -- command zone and battlefield both qualify) + ruling 2 (the persisting counters are NOT 'placed', so Doubling Season doesn't affect them). Expected: keeps all four counters; Doubling Season does NOT double them. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: I cast [Final Fortune] to take an extra turn. During that extra turn I use [Sundial of the Infinite] to end the turn before the end step. Do I still lose the game?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Final Fortune's delayed 'at the beginning of that turn's end step, you lose' trigger + Sundial ruling 1 (end the turn before the end step -> the end step is skipped -> end-step triggers don't trigger) and ruling 4 (end the turn exiles everything on the stack, including can't-be-countered abilities). Expected: No, you don't lose; the delayed loss trigger never triggers (or is exiled if already on the stack) and you keep the extra turn. Same works with Obeka, Brute Chronologist. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: I cast [Clone]. When and how do I choose what it copies, and can my opponent respond to that choice?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Clone ruling 0 (the copy choice does NOT target) + as-enters copy timing (choice made as Clone enters, during its resolution). Expected: you choose as Clone enters, during resolution; it doesn't target, so opponents can respond to the Clone SPELL (e.g., kill the intended creature first) but have no window to respond to what Clone becomes. Rules-gold pending ablation.

question: I activate my [Flooded Strand]'s ability, then activate [Gogo, Master of Mimicry] with X=2 to copy it twice. How many lands do I get from that one Flooded Strand?
note: Jon-approved. Load-bearing: Gogo ruling 2 (copies don't pay the copied ability's activation COSTS -- so the tap/1 life/sacrifice aren't repeated) + ruling 10 (copies resolve before the original) + ruling 12 (a copy isn't 'activated'). Expected: THREE lands -- the fetchland's cost was paid once; the two copies each search+put a land+shuffle, then the original does too. Rules-gold pending ablation.
